decisions.rationale: The draft is useful as an internal proof that the writing harness can move from source packet to critique repair, but it still depends on build-history context and lacks human critique, rendered candidate proof, image contract promotion, and final hash approval.
requiredNextActions: Run a human editorial critique focused on whether the article works for a reader who has not followed the internal build history.
If promoted, add a public post image contract and rendered candidate screenshots.
If promoted, create a hash-bound human approval record after the final markdown and image are stable.
